verdicts.reason: A flips the hierarchy: the subline 'food & drinks' becomes a huge headline that runs into the cup and box image, while the real headline 'Order online' shrinks to a tiny caption at the bottom. Its divider rules also float away from the text they belonged to. B keeps the original reading order, but 'food & drinks' is still bigger than the headline and sits over the kraft box. 'Order online' touches the cup, and the rules are left-aligned and don't line up with the text, so B is also broken, just less so.
